breakdown.description: The prompt makes the torsional shear vanish at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is also maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Do not set torsional shear stress to zero at this surface point' and correctly includes τxy = τ (from torsion) in the plane stress state for computing principal stresses. This directly corrects the flawed instruction in the incomplete prompt that made torsional shear vanish at the outer surface, aligning with the ground truth which properly includes both bending normal stress and torsional shear stress in the stress state analysis.
